The south-east boundary shall be as laid in Santiago
Cadastral Survey No. 211,
Cases Nos. 6 and 10.1
- 2 =
The municipality of Santiago shall consist of its
present territory minus the territory comprised in the
municipality of San Mateo.
The organization herein made shall take effect on
March 17, 1946, subject to the condition that the munic-
ipality of San Mateo shall assume its proportionate share
of the indebtedness of the municipality of Santiago to the
loan fund under the administration of the Agricultural and
Industrial Bank as may be outstanding on the aforesaid date.
Done at the City of Manila, this 7W day of
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-six,
and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the eleventh,
SERGIO OSMEÑA
President of the Philippines
By the President:
Secretary to the President
